Introduction

Bridging the healthcare divide in rural India.

Healix is a forward-thinking healthcare initiative focused on improving medical access in rural India. With community-centric solutions, Healix is addressing healthcare gaps in underserved villages and preparing to launch a nursing home to deliver comprehensive, affordable care to these communities.

The Objective

A brand built on trust, innovation and access.

Healix sought a cohesive brand identity that embodies trust, innovation, and accessibility while aligning with its mission to bridge the healthcare divide in rural India.

Our Process

From values to a consistent visual identity.

01

Client Collaboration

We began by understanding Healix's values and aspirations, ensuring the design reflected their goals and community-driven ethos.

02

Logo Design

A clean, modern logo symbolizing trust, healing, and inclusivity became the centerpiece of their identity.

03

Visiting Card Design

We extended this identity into a professional, well-designed visiting card to reinforce brand consistency.

The Result

A trustworthy, progressive image.

Our designs encapsulate Healix's dedication to rural healthcare and future growth. The logo and collateral establish a trustworthy and progressive image, empowering Healix to make a deeper impact while expanding operations.

Client Impact

With a refined visual identity, Healix can now:

  • 01Enhance trust among rural communities and stakeholders.
  • 02Communicate their mission visually and effectively.
  • 03Expand their presence with a professional brand foundation.

Why Studio 1947?

We transform visions into impactful designs.

At Studio 1947, we transform visions into impactful designs. Our collaboration with Healix highlights our commitment to crafting meaningful, professional brand identities that resonate with purpose and inspire growth.
